name: Can I use a guest home for rental income?

mainEntity.name: Can I use a guest home for rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, guest homes are an excellent option for generating rental income. Many homeowners choose to build ADUs specifically to rent them out on a long-term basis, providing a consistent revenue stream. This can help offset mortgage costs or provide additional financial stability. Local regulations regarding short-term rentals (like Airbnb) can vary, so it's essential to check specific city ordinances if you plan to use it for short-term stays. We recommend understanding your local municipality's specific rental guidelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, guest homes can be used for long-term rental income. Check local ordinances for short-term rental rules, as these vary by city.
